# Tender for Building Design

## 1. Overview
The Client requires architectural and engineering design services for a new 10-storey office building.

## 2. Mandatory Requirements
- M1: The bidder must have at least 10 years of experience in high-rise building design.
- M2: A team of at least 5 experts including a Lead Architect and Senior Structural Engineer.
- M3: Submission must include a Technical Proposal and a Financial Proposal in separate envelopes.

## 3. Deliverables
- D1: Inception Report
- D2: Concept Design
- D3: Detailed Design and BOQ
